ui.game_subtitle: The Quest for the Six Mother Crown Stars
ui.defeat_sub: The Gray Mist made temporary gains, but young King Teodoro dusted himself off and Biscuit rallied the troops!
ui.star_3_criteria: ★★★ 3 Stars: King HP ≥ 85% without losing main defenses
ui.timeline_subtitle: Select an unlocked stage to defend the Kingdom

dialogues.intro_1: Grandma Zenaide: 'Theodoro, sweetie... I told you not to leave the Mother Crown on the windowsill during breakfast.'
dialogues.intro_2: Theodoro: 'But Grandma, Biscoito wanted to admire his shiny reflection!'
dialogues.intro_3: Grandma Zenaide: 'Well, now Baron Ash got moody because he wasn't invited to the festival and took all 6 Stars into the Mist. Grab your wooden sword and go fetch them.'
dialogues.tutorial_move: Grandma Zenaide: 'Drag the virtual stick to walk. No running in socks across the polished floor.'
dialogues.tutorial_coins: Grandma Zenaide: 'Collect the coins on the grass. They're magnetic... cutting edge tech from our local forge.'
dialogues.tutorial_buy: Grandma Zenaide: 'Stand still on the purchase square until the coins fill it up. Archers don't volunteer for free.'
dialogues.tutorial_defense: Grandma Zenaide: 'Here come the Misty critters with cooking pots on their heads. Keep your archers close and smash that Totem!'
dialogues.boss_world_1: Grandma Zenaide: 'That Valley Totem is billowing smoke all over my freshly hung laundry. Knock it down quickly!'
dialogues.stage_2_zenaide: Now enemies are coming in greater numbers! Put archers in Watchtowers to shoot with longer range and more damage.
dialogues.stage_3_zenaide: Misty fiends with barrel lids and coal archers in sight! Use the Field Forge to boost the damage of the entire army.

trophies.title: Kingdom Trophies
trophies.first_victory_desc: Toppled the first Mist Totem in Sunflower Valley.
trophies.catapult_master_desc: Won Challenge 10 and recovered the 1st Crown Star.
trophies.sudoku_wizard_desc: Completed the Number Vault without making mistakes.
trophies.shield_hero_desc: Won Challenge 30 while keeping all 3 lives.
trophies.village_architect_desc: Upgraded every village building at least once.
trophies.full_crown_desc: Recovered all 6 Stars and brought the Baron to the feast.

heroes.marta_skill_desc: Instantly repairs all active palisades in camp.
heroes.fidelio_skill_desc: Freezes enemies near the King for a few seconds.
heroes.rosa_skill_desc: Halves damage taken by the King for 8 seconds.
heroes.clara_skill_desc: Instantly restores 100% health of King and active troops.
heroes.bento_skill_desc: A roar that pushes all nearby enemies away from the King.
heroes.barao_skill_desc: Slows down enemies near the King for 6 seconds.

merchant.bring_spoils: Bring enemy helmets to trade for coins!
